title: backlog.py's set usage says a sprint takes notes and links only, though a sprint's goal is set with --by operator
goal: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-x5gjv4r7, item ST-ifljijni: the facade's set usage text (_tools/backlog.py) still says 'a sprint takes notes and links only' and names no --by operator beside --goal, while bl_items.cmd_set accepts set SP --goal G --by operator and --delegate; the usage names the sprint's goal rule.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import backlog;sys.exit(1 if 'a sprint takes notes and links only' in backlog.__doc__ else 0)
